title: ScientificObjectEnvelope/v1
description: Base envelope for every SRL scientific object. The envelope carries identity (object_id), provenance (created_utc, parents), and the two safety consts (canonical_writes=0, grants_authority=false). The payload is an opaque object whose shape is governed by the object_type-specific sub-schema. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

object_id.description: Content-addressed identity: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the object without this field, prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by srl.contracts.ids.object_id; a pre-populated value is rejected as a self-hash.

object_type.description: Discriminator selecting the payload sub-schema. The enumerated set is the union of all scientific object kinds the fabric produces.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No offset, no fractional seconds.

parents.description: Provenance: the object_ids this object derives from. Each entry is a sha256 id. Empty for a root object.

payload.description: The type-specific payload. Shape is governed by the object_type sub-schema (added in later work packages). The envelope admits any object here so it can carry payloads before every sub-schema is authored.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: an SRL scientific object is immutable once authored. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: an SRL scientific object never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation.
